typography.display: Editorial New or Times New Roman, Light, 84px, -0.02em letter spacing
typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono, Medium, 12px uppercase for utility links
typography.body: Inter or Helvetica Neue, Regular, 16px, 1.6 line-height

design.mood: Serene, sophisticated, and timeless, blending classical editorial elegance with dreamlike digital art.
design.centerpiece: A high-detail, ethereal pastoral landscape illustration featuring rolling green hills, a winding river, and distant blue mountains, positioned in the lower half of the frame.
design.motion: Soft parallax on the landscape layers during scroll. Text elements should use a gentle 'blur-to-clear' fade-in reveal. The CTA buttons utilize a subtle scaling transition on hover.
design.layout: Center-aligned vertical stack with a floating navigation bar. The headline dominates the top third, followed by a narrow paragraph and a pill-shaped CTA, with the image serving as a grounding floor for the composition.
guardrails: Do not use hard shadows or high-contrast color blocks on text.
Avoid heavy geometric shapes; keep the interface secondary to the serif typography and organic imagery.
Do not crowd the landscape illustration with UI elements.
Avoid using vibrant or neon colors outside of the nature illustration.
